He holds no grand ambitions, makes no enemies, and bothers absolutely no one — a comfortable arrangement that suits him perfectly. The only thing that disturbs his carefully cultivated peace is the Emperor.
Six years ago, a runaway assassin grabbed Li Congqing as a hostage, and the Emperor noticed him. This was, in Li Congqing’s considered view, an extreme and undeserved stroke of bad luck. Now the Emperor calls him to private audiences, invites him on banquets and hunting excursions, and occasionally keeps him captive in the Imperial Study until sunrise. Li Congqing endures all of it with the stoic forbearance of a man who has learned that arguing with the Son of Heaven is both exhausting and deeply counterproductive when one is already chronically short of sleep.
He is not invested in this arrangement. He is simply being pragmatic.
(He is completely invested. He has simply not yet examined this too closely.)
When the Emperor sends him south to inspect the remote province of Chu’nan, Li Congqing treats the entire journey as a sightseeing excursion. The Emperor, back in the capital, does not keep a calendar of the days. He absolutely does not keep a calendar.
A warm, witty, low-angst imperial romance about a sovereign who fell first — and fell hard — and a minister who fell quietly, slowly, and entirely without intending to.
The flowers have bloomed on the path; you may come home slowly.

The structure of the first sentence of the synopsis is inspired by “The Painted Veil.”
—-
《面纱》 (The Painted Veil) is a novel by W. Somerset Maugham, published in 1925. The story is set in the 1920s and revolves around the tumultuous marriage of Kitty Garstin and her husband, Walter Fane, a bacteriologist. The plot thickens when Walter discovers Kitty’s infidelity and takes her to a cholera-infected region in China, where he works. The novel explores themes of love, betrayal, redemption, and the complexities of human relationships.
The title “The Painted Veil” refers to a line from Percy Bysshe Shelley’s sonnet “Lift Not the Painted Veil,” which suggests the idea of not looking too closely at life’s illusions or the facade people present to the world.
—-
The phrase “子非鱼” (zǐ fēi yú) originates from the classical Chinese text “Zhuangzi” (also known as “Chuang Tzu”), which is a foundational work of Daoist philosophy. This phrase is part of a longer passage that involves a dialogue between Zhuangzi (also known as Zhuang Zhou) and his friend Huizi (also known as Hui Shi). The dialogue goes as follows:
Zhuangzi and Huizi were strolling along the Hao River when Zhuangzi said:
“The fish are swimming so freely, this is the happiness of fish.”
Huizi replied:
“You are not a fish, how do you know the happiness of fish?”
Zhuangzi responded:
“You are not me, how do you know that I do not know the happiness of fish?”
The phrase “子非鱼” directly translates to “You are not a fish.” It is Huizi’s argument challenging Zhuangzi’s assertion about knowing the happiness of fish. The broader philosophical implications of this dialogue revolve around the nature of knowledge and understanding, especially concerning different perspectives and subjective experiences.

91509.synopsis:
“I told you already, it really was love at first sight. There really won’t be any regret.”
“My dear, you’re still too young and naive. There are many important factors in marriage besides just a face.”
A face? The only things Lily remembered were ‘K’s latest release on the table and the heavy left drawer. His face? Well, it seemed like he looked modest enough, but she couldn’t quite recall.
If their hobbies match, and he’s well-endowed, couldn’t they work out the rest?
—

92277.synopsis:
After waking up from a vegetative state, Chi Suinian discovers three shocking things:
First, His family has gone bankrupt.
Second, He’s married.
Third, And his spouse is none other than his long-time arch-enemy.
Just a couple of days ago, this jerk was fighting him tooth and nail, and now, in the blink of an eye, they’re married?
Chi Suinian: “…”
This is some broad daylight nightmare.
But reality is what it is, indisputable.
After waking up, Chi Suinian finds out that while his own family is bankrupt, his arch-enemy’s company is thriving. Forced by circumstances, he has no choice but to swallow his pride and ask Lu Zhiyue, his nemesis, to invest and save his life.
Unfortunately, that bastard is as despicable as ever.
In the office, Lu Zhiyue, legs crossed, shirt casually unbuttoned to his chest, looks up with a fox-like sly glint in his eyes. “You want an investment? Kiss me first.”
Chi Suinian snaps a pen in half.
As time goes on, Lu Zhiyue’s demands escalate.
Chi Suinian asks for more investment: Kiss me.
Forgets his bank card password: Kiss me.
Wants to borrow the car: Kiss me.
Forgot the keys: Kiss me…
Lu Zhiyue pulls out the keys, “No need to kiss for this one.”
Chi Suinian: “…” Screw you!
After being discharged from the hospital, Chi Suinian and Lu Zhiyue sign an agreement to not interfere with each other’s lives and to peacefully divorce in three years. Lu Zhiyue agrees. But just a few days later, Lu Zhiyue pulls Chi Suinian into bed.
Chi Suinian wakes up covered in hickeys, so angry he sees stars. “This is a sham marriage! Who the hell gave you permission to sleep with me?!”
Lu Zhiyue, eyes sleepy, shamelessly hugs his wife, “Since we’ve already slept together, how about we get married?”
Chi Suinian: ?
“Aren’t we already married?!”
Lu Zhiyue: “…”
Oops, secret’s out.
Main Characters: Chi Suinian, Lu Zhiyue

93813.synopsis:
“I do not have the hobby of sharing what is mine with others.”
This was what her ex-husband spat out in response to Therese’s request for a divorce.
But how did things end up like this?
In this second chance at life, she had promised herself never to fall in love again.
Yet her ex-husband had become utterly leech-like, refusing to let go.
“I assume you like my face.”
“I’d prefer to stay where you can see me.”
“I find myself getting jealous all the time.”
He would say these nonsensical things,
but Therese had no intention of repeating her foolish past.
She knew that the only end to this hellish marriage was death.
Nevertheless, her husband’s obsession continued endlessly.
***
“I have not changed my mind about wanting a divorce, Your Grace.”

At that moment, tears started flowing down the Duke’s cheeks.
“For someone like me, there’s no room for a new love.”
The Duke whispered as his long fingers tousled Therese’s silver hair.
The tremor at his fingertips told her it was genuine.

94837.synopsis:
After suffering from a high fever, I realized I had been reborn as a villain in a novel.
I was the villain who dies after tormenting my half-sister Irene, the female protagonist, out of jealousy.
But there was something even more important than that.
‘Luwen exists in this world.’
The character I loved most while reading the novel.
Luwen, the second male lead who steadfastly loves the female lead until sacrificing his life.
What if he hadn’t fallen in love with the female lead?
This was my chance to act on the daydreams I had in my previous life.
‘I can change Luwen’s ending.’
Yes, I’m just slightly altering the future of the second male lead, who’s still only twelve.
‘Luwen, I’ll change your life’s genre to a happy ending.’
It might be an arrogant thought.
But I’ve always been a selfish person who only thinks about myself.
So I’ll do as I please.
Even if I can’t be a good person, I can pretend to be one, right?
Even if I’m not the type to sacrifice myself for others, I can paint a convincing picture.
So, Luwen, let’s survive and find happiness.
Don’t step into your predetermined tragic fate. I’ll protect you as your brother.

95093.synopsis:
After retiring as the King of Ghost Kings, Guo Dong found a strange job: guarding a door in a peculiar underground warehouse.
The job was odd, sure, but with a monthly salary of 50,000 yuan and even a cremation subsidy after death, Guo Dong took it without hesitation—for the sake of the limited-edition dolls he’d bought on installment plans lasting twenty years.
On his first day at work, Guo Dong saw a group of people sneakily shove a legendary human-skin ghost through the door. That human-skin ghost seemed to be his former pet…
On the second day, the same group came back, this time with a ghost king (who also happened to be his former subordinate).
On the third day, Guo Dong realized that the door he was guarding seemed to be the enemy’s prison.
On the fourth day, his boss selected him to join a team to enter a dungeon and fight ghosts.
Guo Dong: “…I refuse.”
Chen Ran: “I’ll pay overtime.”
Guo Dong: “(☆_☆) If there’s overtime pay, I’ll endure anything! Boss, you’re the best!”
All the ghosts: “???”
—
Arranged ghost marriages, cursed children, human sacrifices in deserted villages, live skinning, haunted wooden dolls…
Chen Ran initially thought that as an ordinary human, Guo Dong wouldn’t survive even one dungeon. But unexpectedly, Guo Dong lived unusually long.
Chen Ran was very surprised.
Until one day, he saw the rabbit Guo Dong always carried suddenly transform into a berserk state, pinning a boss-level ghost king to the ground and beating it until it wanted to give up on life.
Chen Ran: “???”
—
Bonus Scene:
Guo Dong was horrified to discover his boss constantly staring at his dolls.
Guo Dong (hugging them tightly): “They’re mine!”
Chen Ran (coldly): “What’s so fun about dolls?”
Later, Guo Dong discovered that Chen Ran was right—there was indeed something more fun than dolls in this world.
Chen Ran (holding his waist): “…”

96373.synopsis:
In the second year of Chenghe, new talents enter the palace.
Ruan Yun was originally a maid in the flower house. With hair dark as clouds and skin pale as porcelain, she is chosen by Yu Ronghua to help secure imperial favor.
Unintentionally drawn into the harem’s struggles, she finds those in power pressing her step by step. For the sake of self-preservation, Ruan Yun deliberately turns her gaze toward the emperor seated high above.
On the palace road, as the imperial carriage arrives, everyone bows their heads in reverence—only Ruan Yun lifts her eyes gracefully, her apricot gaze shimmering and catching the emperor’s attention.
Late at night, she kneels by the emperor’s feet, jade fingers offering a cup of hot tea—yet seizes the moment to hook his belt.
Since she must compete, she aims only for the highest position. She refuses to be submerged and forgotten in the depths of the harem.
From a humble palace maid, she rises five ranks in succession to become a consort. Countless people envy and resent her, waiting for her to fall from grace. Instead, she ends up crowned in splendor, standing above them all.
Everyone says Ruan Yun is calculating and unfaithful, betraying her former mistress. Hearing such words, she merely smiles faintly.
In this harem, it has never been a place to judge right and wrong.
After all, the emperor’s favor belongs to her alone.

I transmigrated into a cultivation fantasy world—a fusion realm of various xianxia novels—and became a “villain” who had guarded the Demon Cave for decades. Despite my great military achievements, I was still scorned and hated by the sect.

128117.synopsis: A young life was coming to an end in a hospital room in his bed. His name was Tendo Hikaru. He had been living in an institution since he lost his parents in a fire at the age of five. After leaving the institution at 18, he worked at a subcontracted factory, but the working conditions were so bad that he was hospitalized after just two years. Today, just over 20 years old, he lost his life alone in a hospital room…
associated_names: 苔から始まる異世界ライフ（旧　苔から始まる異世界生活）

134773.synopsis:
A love chosen by someone else doesn’t always lead to unhappiness. In fact, perhaps it’s precisely because it was arranged that it can begin the right way.
Born as the eldest son of the prestigious former noble Ichijo family, high schooler Minato is suddenly informed by his father that his fiancée has been decided. As the heir to a distinguished household, freedom was never part of the equation — something he had accepted long ago. With a dry sense of resignation, Minato follows his father’s instructions and heads to the arranged meeting.
“I’m Nanase Rei, eldest daughter of the Nanase family. I look forward to our life together, dear husband.”
But the girl waiting for him is none other than Nanase Rei — the cold-hearted beauty from his class, known for her icy demeanor.
Thus begins their shared life, along with Rei’s relentless and unexpected affection.
Though Minato is bewildered by the sudden turn of events, he soon realizes that this new chapter may not be so bad after all — and slowly, he begins to feel happiness in the life he shares with Rei.
associated_names: Kurokami Seiso no Reikoku Bishoujo o Tasuketara, Ore to Futarikiri no Toki dake Dereru You ni Natta Ken

145269.synopsis:
After dying from overwork, Xu Xi transmigrates to another world invaded by a survival game.
To his shock, he gains a bizarre ability: every time he dies, he can rewind time.
Using this death-rewind power, Xu Xi repeatedly escapes danger and clears deadly dungeons—
And in the process, he accidentally becomes famous in the real world livestream audience, who mistake him for a mysterious top-tier strategist.
“How the hell did he know that would work?!”
“What’s Xu Xi planning this time? Can some big-brain explain? I’m lost, man!”
“D*mn—such unfathomable depth, meticulous thinking, and flawless execution! He’s a god!”
“He may look unremarkable, but he’s clearly pulling the strings from the shadows!”
If Xu Xi could hear their praise, he’d probably cry out in utter grievance:
“No! You’re overthinking it! I’m not a genius! Not a mastermind! Not a tactician! I just DIED for that knowledge!”
associated_names: 回档求生：我真不是大佬啊

196725.synopsis:
Everyone at the Dimensional Management Bureau knew just how much their boss, Chen Tian, loved his partner, Bai Su. The two had gone through countless trials and hardships just to finally be together.
But on the eve of their honeymoon, the Bureau was attacked once again.
In order to save others, Bai Su was tainted by corruption and had no choice but to fall into various minor worlds, traveling through them to protect himself.
So, Chen Tian could only follow Bai Su from world to world, protecting him while gathering the world’s fate energy to help repair his shattered soul.
Tainted by corruption, Bai Su lost all his memories. Yet, the love he had for Chen Tian, etched into the depths of his soul, turned into an obsessive madness. In every world, he descended into darkness.
Faced once more with his lover pinning him to a corner, Chen Tian wiped the tear from the corner of his mouth and said, “To think such a good thing could happen again!”

198517.synopsis:
In the same room of an apartment where all kinds of people may have lived.
Everyone has their own story, are you ready to listen to their story?
